articles.title: Can the government actually end rough sleeping by Christmas?  | BBC Newscast
articles.titleZh: 政府真的可以在圣诞节前结束粗暴睡眠吗？ | BBC新闻广播
articles.summary:
Today, Andy Burnham has doubled the funding for his pledge to get rough sleepers off the streets by Christmas. £432 million pound will be announced for the plan in Wednesday’s budget. Adam and Chris are joined by housing correspondent Tarah Welsh to discuss how the money could be spent and why the government has chosen to focus on rough sleeping.

Plus, with elections taking place in Brazil and Serbia over the weekend and Israeli voters set to go to the polls tomorrow Adam caught up with political scientist Ben Ansell from the University of Oxford to break down what the elections tell us about trends in global politics.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: How Brazil's President Lula beat Bolsonaro in a runoff election | Global News Podcast
articles.titleZh: 巴西总统卢拉如何在第二轮选举中击败博尔索纳罗|全球新闻播客
articles.summary:
Has Brazil turned back the tide of right-wing, pro-Trump leaders, sweeping across Latin America? Left-wing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won re-election against Flavio Bolsonaro - the son of the jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro, whose family has close ties to Donald Trump. Analysts have described it as a stunning comeback victory, after Lula finished second to Mr Bolsonaro in the first round of voting. Mr Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat, and is calling for the result of be annulled. 

In this episode, we look at how President Lula's campaign turned its fortunes around, and ask what grounds Mr Bolsonaro has to challenge the election outcome. Plus, we'll ask our reporter what Lula's victory means for Brazil's position in an increasingly conservative region, and the country's relationship with Washington. 

00:00 Introduction
1:46 Lula is re-elected in Brazil 
04:24 Why is Flavio Bolsonaro rejecting Brazil's election result?
06:12 Brazil, Trump and right-wing populism in Latin America

The Global News Podcast brings you the best of the BBC’s news coverage and analysis from around the world. New audio episodes of the Global News Podcast are published twice a day. You can listen here: https://link.mgln.ai/GNP-YT

And you can find more of our YouTube episodes here: https://bbc.in/GlobalNewsPodcast

If you would like to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk. 

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: 'Dead wrong': Legal analyst picks apart Blanche's AK election lawsuit
articles.titleZh: “大错特错” ：法律分析师将布兰奇的AK选举诉讼分开
articles.summary:
CNN senior legal analyst Elie Honig explains that Attorney General Todd Blanche and the DOJ have ‘no legal relevance’ to intervene in Alaska and California's elections. 

Last week, the Trump administration preemptively filed a lawsuit seeking to block certification of Alaska’s US Senate election if the Republican incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan loses in the critical contest which could decide the balance of power in the Senate. 

Also, Longtime Republican election lawyer Ben Ginsberg points out this isn't the first time Sen. Dan Sullivan has been joined on an Alaskan ballot by another Dan Sullivan. 

0:00 AG Todd Blanche defends the DOJ's preemptive Alaska election lawsuit 
1:20 Elie Honig says Blanche is "simply dead wrong" 
5:29 Trump speaks out about the Alaska lawsuit 
6:28 GOP election lawyer says the Trump admin is "trying to hide behind the law" 
11:45 CNN political analyst calls the lawsuit "a major escalation" 

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#ToddBlanche #Trump #News

Dan Sullivan loses in the critical contest which could decide the balance of power in the Senate.

Dan Sullivan has been joined on an Alaskan ballot by another Dan Sullivan.

美国有线电视新闻网高级法律分析师埃利·霍尼格（ Elie Honig ）解释说，司法部长托德·布兰奇（ Todd Blanche ）和司法部对干预阿拉斯加和加利福尼亚州的选举“没有法律意义”。

上周，特朗普政府先发制人地提起诉讼，试图阻止共和党现任参议员对阿拉斯加州美国参议院选举的认证。

丹·沙利文（ Dan Sullivan ）在可能决定参议院权力平衡的关键竞赛中失利。

此外，长期担任共和党选举律师的本·金斯伯格（ Ben Ginsberg ）指出，这不是参议院第一次。

Dan Sullivan与另一位Dan Sullivan一起参加了阿拉斯加的投票。

articles.title: This officer used Flock to track his diabetic wife. Then he was fired
articles.titleZh: 这名警官使用Flock来追踪他患有糖尿病的妻子。然后他被解雇了
articles.summary: The wife of a former police officer who says he was fired for using Flock has come forward to defend him. Mariam Dula says her husband, Randy Dula, used the technology to find his wife as she often suffered from diabetic emergencies. It’s a crime in Georgia to use Flock outside of law enforcement purposes. Dula is appealing his termination, his attorney says.

The wife of a former police officer who says he was fired for using Flock has come forward to defend him.

Mariam Dula says her husband, Randy Dula, used the technology to find his wife as she often suffered from diabetic emergencies.

It’s a crime in Georgia to use Flock outside of law enforcement purposes.

Dula is appealing his termination, his attorney says.

在格鲁吉亚，在执法目的之外使用Flock属于犯罪行为。

他的律师说，杜拉正在对他的解雇提出上诉。
